Our standards

Trust is earned.

Accuracy and corrections

We aim to verify factual statements against primary sources, correct errors and distinguish opinion from reporting. Readers may request corrections through the publication contact channel when configured.

Ownership and conflicts

Amar Pearson is the publisher. Businesses connected to the publisher must be clearly labeled. Inclusion does not imply independent endorsement.

Advertising

Sponsored articles, paid directory placements and advertising must be explicitly labeled and separated from editorial judgments. Payment will not buy an undisclosed ranking.

AI assistance

AI may support research and drafting, but publication requires human fact-checking, source review and approval. Unverified automated posting is not permitted.
